newsitem.title: USA: Clinton calls Israeli, PLO leaders.
newsitem.headline: Clinton calls Israeli, PLO leaders.

text.p: President Bill Clinton on Sunday called Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat to encourage them to do everything possible to resolve their outstanding issues, White House spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters.

McCurry said Clinton had spoken to each leader for about 10 minutes in order to "encourage them to do everything they can to address the remaining issues relating to Oslo implementation and specifically security related issues and the withdrawal from Hebron."
